data_flows.purpose: A driving database that the Texas AG and a federal class action allege was sold to insurers, who used it to raise premiums
data_flows.wording: Alleged by the Texas AG and in a federal class action; not proven in court. Part of the Texas case was dismissed on jurisdiction grounds and is under appeal.

procedural_note.text: On 2025-04-10 the Texas court dismissed The Allstate Corporation and Arity 875 LLC for lack of personal jurisdiction (MLex); that dismissal is on appeal and the case continues against the remaining Allstate entities.

sources.title: MLex

sources.quote: this information was sold or used to make decisions concerning the plaintiffs' insurance coverage and premiums … the defendants' motion is granted in part and denied in part

consequences.text: The Texas AG and a federal class action allege that Allstate's Arity paid app makers to embed its SDK, built a driving database on 45 million+ Americans, and sold the data to insurers, who used it to raise premiums. Third-party app makers such as Life360 are not defendants.
consequences.wording: Alleged by the Texas AG and in a federal class action; not proven in court. Part of the Texas case was dismissed on jurisdiction grounds and is under appeal.
